game_abilities.title_en: Holding Block at Ranged Distance for <s>0.9</s> {{var_1}} will Swap Autobot Hound’s Ammo Types.
game_abilities.desc_zh: 在远程距离保持格挡 <s>0.9</s> {{var_1}} 将交换汽车人猎犬的弹药类型。

game_abilities.title_en: Inferno Ammo grants Critical Ranged Hits a {{var_2}} chance to inflict Burn, dealing {{var_3}} of Attack as Heat damage over {{var_4}}seconds.
game_abilities.desc_zh: 地狱弹药使致命远程命中有 {{var_2}} 几率造成燃烧，在 {{var_4}} 秒内造成 {{var_3}} 点攻击力热力伤害。

game_abilities.title_en: The third hit of a Ranged Combo has a {{var_5}} chance to refresh the timer of a Burn Debuff.
game_abilities.desc_zh: 远程连击的第三次命中有 {{var_5}} 几率刷新燃烧减益计时器。

game_abilities.title_en: Precision Ammo grants Ranged Attacks a {{var_6}} increased Critical Rate and cannot be Evaded and is not affected by abilities that would cause Ranged Attacks to Miss.
game_abilities.desc_zh: 精确弹药使远程攻击的暴击率提升 {{var_6}}，且无法躲避，并且不受导致远程攻击失手的能力影响。

game_abilities.title_en: The second hit of a basic ranged combo has a {{var_7}} chance to Nullify a Shield Buff on the opponent.
game_abilities.desc_zh: 基本远程连击的第二次攻击有 {{var_7}} 几率使对手的护盾增益无效。

game_abilities.title_en: The third hit of a basic ranged combo has an {{var_8}} chance to Nullity a Shield Buff on the opponent.
game_abilities.desc_zh: 基本远程连击的第三次打击有 {{var_8}} 几率使对手的护盾增益无效。

game_abilities.title_en: Sidestepping with Precision Ammo Purifies all Daze effects.
game_abilities.desc_zh: 使用精密弹药进行回避净化了所有眩晕效果。

game_abilities.title_en: Ranged Attacks: Critical Hits on Burning opponents have 50~% Critical Damage.
game_abilities.desc_zh: 远程攻击：对燃烧的对手造成暴击，造成 50% 的暴击伤害。

game_abilities.title_en: {{var_9}} Chance to gain an Armor Buff, reducing damage from attacks by {{var_10}} for {{var_11}}.
game_abilities.desc_zh: {{var_9}} 有机会获得装甲增益，减少 {{var_10}} 对 {{var_11}} 攻击造成的伤害。

game_abilities.title_en: {{var_12}} Chance to inflict a Critical Resistance Debuff, increasing the chance for Critical Hits against opponents by {{var_13}}? for {{var_14}}seconds.
game_abilities.desc_zh: {{var_12}} 有机会造成致命一击减益，增加 {{var_13}} 对对手致命一击的几率？为 {{var_14}} 秒。
